name: k8s factory — a ResourceQuota stays at or above 90% of hard in factory or factory-mi-homelab for 2 hours
description: Fires, per namespace and constrained resource, when the LOWEST used/hard ratio over the trailing 2 h is at or above 0.90: the quota stayed nearly full for two hours. The Dispatcher admits to quota by design, so a shorter window fires on normal operation. Measured 2026-11-04 over 72 h: factory requests.cpu was at or above 0.9 in 20% of 15-min buckets, the longest stretch was 75 min, and the Pending-pod trigger never fired (plan address-honeycomb-alerts, epic bd-ib-xkwdap). Two hours at quota means a leak (pods or cleanup pods holding quota with no runs) or a wedged drain. Emitter: k8s_cluster on the poweredge-xubuntu collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml). Receiver: that collector -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: kubectl describe resourcequota -n <ns>; kubectl get pods -n <ns> -o wide --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp. Spec v131 §"Runner-pool workload and control-plane telemetry"; item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
